name: std/unicode
readme: Import this module with use unicode.

files.content:
-- Declares Unicode validation and conversion.
public define Cursor as opaque.
public use "unicode" function scan(value of type text) of type fallible pointer to Cursor.
public use "unicode" function next(value of type pointer to Cursor) of type optional unsigned 32.
public use "unicode" function release(value of type pointer to Cursor) of type nothing.
public use "unicode" function valid(value of type text) of type boolean.
public use "unicode" function points(value of type text) of type fallible sequence of unsigned 32.
public use "unicode" function wide(value of type text) of type fallible sequence of unsigned 16.
public use "unicode" function narrow(value of type sequence of unsigned 16) of type fallible text.
